# Dragoon's Town v0.25

Related systems now share clearer menu areas, and a complete guide explains how the game works. Existing progress and the current economy remain compatible.

- Five tabs: Town, Manage, Assets, Progress and Guide. The gear opens settings, saves and app updates.
- Manage combines businesses, taps, specializations, automation, supply chains, statistics and maximum buying. Assets combines homes, vehicles, estates, teams, rentals, commercial fleets and markets. Progress combines expansion, goals, contracts, prestige, achievements, design and events.
- Keep your current subpage and estate/sport filters when moving between workspaces. Existing purchases and upgrades keep their behavior and stable buttons.
- Explore 16 tutorial chapters, 34 lessons and 63 detailed steps covering every existing mechanic, including Estates, Teams and Markets. Search, jump to chapters, resume, replay and track which steps you have read.
- “Show me in the game” opens the relevant controls without buying or resetting anything. The guide explains fees, income bonuses, staff perks, offline limits, permanent holdings and prestige reset rules.
- Reading progress is local and separate from your game save. Restarting the guide leaves your empire unchanged. Existing completed quick-start tutorials stay completed.
- Improve touch layouts and keyboard focus in portrait and landscape. Settings retains backup/recovery and Android update controls.

No business prices, income formulas, milestone thresholds, prestige rules or save formats change. No real payments, ads or paid servers were added.

Android players use the gear → App updates → Check now, then install over the existing app without uninstalling. Browser players use the same game link and refresh an open page.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex. Physical Thor/Android 13 installation and sustained performance remain separate playtests.
